property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.service.name
property.description: Name of the Ranger service containing policies for this NiFi Registry instance

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.policy.source.impl
property.description: Class to retrieve policies from the source

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.policy.rest.ssl.config.file
property.description: Path to the file containing SSL details to contact Ranger Admin

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.policy.pollIntervalMs
property.description: How often to poll for changes in policies?

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.policy.cache.dir
property.description: Directory where Ranger policies are cached after successful retrieval from the source

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.policy.rest.client.connection.timeoutMs
property.description: RangerRestClient Connection Timeout in Milli Seconds

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.policy.rest.client.read.timeoutMs
property.description: RangerRestClient read Timeout in Milli Seconds

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.enable.implicit.userstore.enricher
property.description: The plugin downloads the users and groups known to Ranger, needed by use.rangerGroups.

property.name: ranger.plugin.nifi-registry.use.rangerGroups
property.description: Resolve the groups of the requesting user from Ranger: NiFi Registry itself passes none to Ranger, so group policies (nifiadmin) would never match.
